## Company Overview

Eden operates in Healthcare & Life Sciences and is based in Mexico City. Its latest recorded funding round was a Series A round in October 2025.

Eden is a healthcare technology company that provides an AI-and-cloud-native diagnostic operating system for medical imaging and previously developed non-invasive breast health monitoring technology.

Eden is a private company.

Eden is a private company, so its shares have no public market price. Caplight tracks Eden's secondary market activity and provides MarketPrice™ estimates of its share price to Caplight users.

Valuation information for Eden is not publicly available.

Eden shares may be available on secondary markets subject to transfer restrictions. Caplight facilitates secondary market transactions for accredited investors.

Eden's most recent funding round was Series A on October 10, 2025.

Key investors in Eden include Sierra Ventures.

Will Eden IPO soon?

No public IPO plans have been announced for Eden.
